newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures end restless day mixed.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures end restless day mixed.

text.p: April 24 - IMM currency futures ended mixed, after a restless session caught near Thursday's closing levels. Yen futures dipped to low on talk Japan's MOF was preparing to halt operations at Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Co, but showed scant folowthrough. Various comments from IMF's Camdessus, Buba's Tietmeyer, Fed's Meyer ignored. Market awaits Clinton-Hashimoto meeting, G7.
